OUT-OF-SCOPE FINDING (reporting, not absorbing — no work done on it here).

The parent epic guiltless-supporting-grayling is titled '6 uncovered files at 786-800' and lists 6 children. That census is now STALE. Measured on origin/main 6a4fd2fbb0, the >=786 LOC set is 12 files, and 6 of them have NO ticket under the epic:

  800  src/rebar/signing.py                                  <- AT THE CAP, untracked
  799  src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/reconcile.py       <- untracked
  798  src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py        <- untracked
  793  src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py                 <- untracked
  791  src/rebar/_config_sources.py                          <- untracked
  790  src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sidecar.py                  <- untracked

Tracked (existing children): inbound_differ.py 800, apply_inbound_records.py 799, det_floor.py 793, workflow/executor.py 790, prompting/prompts.py 789, _commands/init.py 786.

signing.py at exactly 800 is the same zero-headroom condition this ticket was filed for. _config_sources.py at 791 is notable here because it is the sibling this split leans on.

36 files total sit in the gate's >=720 near-cap warning band.

Deliberately NOT acting on any of this: filing children under an in-progress epic is a backlog-shaping decision for the operator, and this change stays a single-seam split.
